build.//: Override of the `build` target inferred by @nx/js/typescript (see that plugin's registration in nx.json for why the inferred `tsc --build tsconfig.lib.json` cannot run in this workspace).

typecheck.//: Type-checks the SOURCE corpus (tsconfig.typecheck.json). It now depends on `typecheck-spec` so the source type-check also pulls in the spec-corpus gate; and because the workspace `build` targetDefault depends on `typecheck`, a build reaches it too. One of the two wiring points (the other is `test.dependsOn`) that close the gate-that-cannot-fail class for this package — the `@ts-expect-error` in src/__tests__/task-list-contract.test.ts had no compiling target.

typecheck-spec.//: Type-checks the SPEC corpus (tsconfig.spec.json) — the gate that did not exist. Closes the gate-that-cannot-fail class (98142eab instance 3) for this package: tsconfig.lib.json AND tsconfig.typecheck.json both exclude src/**/*.test.ts, so no target compiled the specs, and the `@ts-expect-error` in src/__tests__/task-list-contract.test.ts asserting the ProjectedTask projection type (f1b462b3) was unenforced — reverting the task.ts overloads to `Task[]` compiled clean. The ratchet baselines the 44 pre-existing spec errors (baselined, NOT excluded) and fails on any per-file increase or on include narrowing; the revert adds an unused-directive error at task-list-contract.test.ts (2 -> 3) and fails this gate. Wired into BOTH typecheck.dependsOn (so `build` reaches it) and test.dependsOn (so `nx affected -t test` runs it), mirroring entrypoint/backlog + apigen-plugin-tracing.

test.//: Partial override — executor/cache/outputs/options still come from the inferred @nx/vitest target. dependsOn is replaced wholesale, so lint/^build (the workspace test targetDefaults) are relisted here, plus typecheck-spec so the spec corpus is gated whenever tests run (mirrors entrypoint/backlog + apigen-plugin-tracing).
